provenance.description: Unmodified closed exterior rings decoded by production MVT.decodeTile from repository Kelowna OpenFreeMap z14 fixtures. OpenFreeMap building features combine many OSM-derived rings: feature IDs below are MVT IDs, not asserted individual OSM way IDs. Raw vertex arrays retained exactly, including closing vertex. localMeters only translates/scales, with no snapping, simplification, orthogonalization or reshaping.
